category: Units of Measurement with Common, Unrelated Meanings
explanation: Foot, Yard, Pound, and Stone are all units of measurement that also serve as common English words with distinct, unrelated meanings (e.g., a body part, an outdoor area, to strike, a rock). Mile, while a unit of length, primarily functions in that context and does not have an unrelated common meaning in the same way.

category: Traditional Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
explanation: The Great Pyramid of Giza, Hanging Gardens of Babylon, Colossus of Rhodes, and Lighthouse of Alexandria are all commonly listed among the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Machu Picchu, while a world wonder, is a later Incan site and not part of the traditional ancient list.
All tokens except 'Baton' are established units of measurement for speed, mass, length, and area respectively. 'Baton' is an object.
